children: Partnership integrates FanDuel odds and contextual markets into Real's live experience and creates a new way for FanDuel to connect with the next generation of sports fans

NEW YORK, Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Real App, the social sports app built around live play by play, real time stats and fan conversation, today named FanDuel, North America's Premier Online Gaming company, its first Official and Exclusive Sportsbook and Prediction Market Partner. The partnership will bring FanDuel odds and contextual markets directly into Real's live sports experience, giving members another way to understand, discuss and engage with the games they follow together on the platform. It will also position Real as a key destination for FanDuel to connect with the next generation of sports fans.

With over 1.5 million monthly active users, Real App has grown by making the live sports experience more immediate, interactive and social. Members use the app to track games and player performances in real time, react to key moments and debate what happens next with other fans.

"Our members are already using Real to track and discuss their bets in real time, and they've been requesting live odds," said Louis Antonelli, co-founder of Real. "Partnering with a trusted brand like FanDuel gives us a new layer of real-time sports data that we can surface in ways that are additive to the Real experience for members interested in betting."

FanDuel odds, markets and related visualizations will appear across Real game feeds, play level views, player performance screens, team box scores and other real time surfaces. Contextual markets will be surfaced around key game moments, with links that take eligible users directly to the applicable FanDuel experience. The design will pair familiar FanDuel odds presentation with Real's native interface, providing additional context without disrupting the experience that has made Real a natural gathering place for digitally first sports fans. The initial integration will begin for the start of the 2026 NFL season with a commitment to further integrations in the future.

"Some of the best parts of being a sports fan happen around the game - talking about what just happened, debating what comes next and sharing those moments with other fans," said Christian Genetski, President of FanDuel. "Real has built a great community around that experience. We're excited to work with them and find new ways to make FanDuel a natural part of how fans follow and engage with sports."

FanDuel and Real encourage fans to enjoy sports responsibly and are both committed to ensuring entertainment remains the primary focus of the experience. FanDuel odds and related features will be optional, and members will be able to disable them through their Real app settings. FanDuel is deeply committed to promoting responsible gaming and has developed comprehensive tools to help its customers set appropriate limits and engage safely with its platform.

Real App (realapp.com) is the fastest-growing live social sports app, serving 1.1 million daily and 1.5 million monthly active users across 18 leagues. Fans use Real to follow every play, track player performances and discuss live moments. For many fans, Real is now the first place they learn what is happening in sports.

Engagement spikes around exciting live moments, with more than 70% of monthly active users returning on major game days and concurrent users surpassing 250,000 during close games. In the last 12 months, users have spent 4.8 billion minutes on the app. Real delivers 50 million notifications per day, and nearly 30% of monthly users actively comment.
Real covers 18 leagues across the NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, WNBA, college sports, global soccer, tennis and more, with F1, horse racing and additional sports coming soon.

FanDuel is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States. FanDuel consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; its new prediction markets platform, FanDuel Predicts; its industry-leading horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. FanDuel has a presence nationwide with offices in New York, Los Angeles, Atlanta and Jersey City, as well as in Canada, Scotland, Ireland, Portugal, Romania and Australia.
